design_rationale:
WHY A GOOD TEST. Marisol Trevino asks to file a Northgate Marketplace Guarantee claim for four platters that arrived not as described from an International Seller (Ravello Artisan Imports, paid with an external card). The amount claimed is the price paid for the requested units still unrefunded (set price), less their share of a seller partial refund and the promotional value attributable to them (gift ledger), plus their shipping share, less their share of a shipping refund, limited to the room left under the per-order guarantee maximum where undecided claims reserve their claimed amount. A not-received claim for a missing rug is past its seller response period and undecided, and a change-of-mind refund on the bowls withheld more restocking than Northgate's schedule allows; the claim's prerequisite sentences make the agent settle both first.

SCOPE. Task 1 claims market_ext_item_condition_claim_amount (root; owner=user tool file_item_condition_claim_763dfc78), market_ext_restocking_topup (refund_restocking_shortfall_469f1911) and market_ext_missing_item_reimbursement (grant_missing_item_claim_35c21a00); disjoint from task 0.

PROBLEM TREE (draw: prerequisite_problems 2, factor_counts [5, 5, 4]: claim 5, missing-item reimbursement 5, top-up 4).
- root <- missing-item reimbursement: value_input on q_room, state form ("Where the order carries exactly one not-received claim whose claim record shows no decision, the amount claimed for an item not as described is fixed only after that claim, if its seller response period has run out, the seller has not refunded every one of its claimed units and its claimed line carries no return request, carries a decision on its claim record; where that claim is referred to a human representative under its own policy, the filing is referred too and nothing is filed."). Opening: the rug claim (filed 2026-10-13, seller deadline 2026-10-16) has claim_decision not_applicable. Skipping it gives 334.19 instead of 367.2.
- root <- top-up: state_gate in the action form ("The amount claimed for an item not as described is not fixed until Northgate has settled the restocking top-up on the return request most recently answered on the order with a return authorization."); the top-up's own scope names that same request; fallback: a top-up figure of zero books nothing, so no record marks the settlement. Opening: the bowl refund of 2026-10-09 (the order's single return authorization) withheld 20 percent on a request made 6 days after delivery (schedule: half the maximum) and no top-up stands. Skipping it leaves the claim at 367.2.
- The two prerequisites commute (both orders replayed identical).

FACTOR CARDS (tier taken; result with only that factor at its baseline).
- top-up 5.98 (all-baseline 22.61): line pricing withdrawal (9.82); restocking schedule half the maximum (15.39); partial share (7.48); promotional recovery (7.86); the seller's unit refund on the line is subtracted.
- missing-item reimbursement 2097.33 (all-baseline 2329.0): line pricing set price (2209.33); partial share (2114.83); promotional recovery (2139.82); shipping value share (2148.51); shipping-refund set-off (2105.83).
- claim 367.2 (all-baseline 402.67): line pricing set price (387.0); partial share (373.87); promotional recovery (374.72); shipping value share (402.67); shipping-refund set-off (368.71).
- Cross-difficulty: promotional recovery reads gift_holdings / gift_events. Multi-source: restocking schedule (reason AND days), promotional recovery (qualifying card AND spend AND merchandise kept after the refund against the qualifying total). The promotion is Northgate's own; only value already spent is recovered, in proportion to the merchandise refunded, the whole remaining value only on a refund that leaves the kept merchandise below the qualifying total, and nothing on a refund made once it is already below.
- Near-misses: partial refunds on the rug and bowl lines never enter the platter claim; the partial refunds that settled buyer contacts are not return requests, so each claimed line still carries only its own request; the bowl refund and top-up are on another line.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. claim_window: 2026-09-30 + 90 calendar days inclusive -> 2026-12-29; filing 2026-10-22 inside. Seller contact 2026-10-14 plus two business days (2026-10-16). Card-dispute exclusion met by the external-card payment record. One claim in 12 months. reimburse_once: the rug claim carries no reimbursement. Not-received wait (7 days after 2026-09-30) passed before the 2026-10-13 filing.

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. The claim's items are the only not_as_described request (platter line, 4 units, none refunded). The top-up attaches to the request most recently answered with a return authorization (bowl line); the grant to the not-received claim row.

PERSONA. Calm, organised designer; volunteers only the four platters, the 2026-10-14 request and message; identity and order number on request; passive go-ahead; files with the agent's figures; ends after the claim reference.

STANDARD SOLUTION. find_customers -> verify_customer_identity -> find_market_holdings -> find_market_events -> find_gift_holdings -> find_gift_events -> top-up 5.98 -> grant not-received claim 2097.33 -> hand over the filing (platter line, 4 units, 367.2). Recomputed by task1_build.py with check_compute's evaluator on the handling-time world and replayed with the real tools. Rework changes: see worklog.md and rework_claims_r2.md / rework_claims_r3.md / rework_claims_r4.md.
user_scenario:
You are Marisol Trevino, a graphic designer in Portland, Oregon, calling Northgate customer care on your lunch break; you are calm, organised and like to understand what is going on. In late August you ordered pieces for your dining room on Northgate Marketplace from an international seller called Ravello Artisan Imports. Four of the six hand-painted majolica serving platters arrived with crazed, cloudy glaze that looks nothing like the listing photos. On October 14 you asked the seller to take those four platters back and sent them a message about it, and you have heard nothing since. You want to file a Northgate Marketplace Guarantee claim for the four platters that are not as described, and you are happy to file it yourself; you do not know what amount the claim should be for and expect the agent to work it out.
When the agent asks how to find you, you give your mobile number 5035550117; if a second detail is needed you give your date of birth, 1995-03-08, and you give your email marisol.trevino@fastmail.com only if asked. Your marketplace order number is M51862209473 and you read it out if asked. If the agent asks about anything else on that order, you say there were a couple of other issues with the seller over the past weeks and that the details should be in their records; you do not remember amounts.
Whenever the agent explains that something else on the order needs to be processed or settled before your claim can be filed, you tell them that is fine and to go ahead. When the agent hands the claim over for you to file, you file it exactly with the order, item line, number of platters and amount the agent gives you, and you read back the claim reference you receive. If the agent tells you the amount, you accept it. Once the claim is filed you thank the agent and say goodbye.

edges.condition: where the order carries exactly one not_received market_open_claim with claim_decision not_applicable, that claim, if past its seller response period with claimed units still unrefunded and no market_request_return row on its claimed line, has claim_decision granted (with its market_decide_claim and market_guarantee_reimburse rows) or denied_not_covered (with its market_decide_claim row); a claim its policy refers to a human representative refers the filing too
edges.policy_source: Where the order carries exactly one not-received claim whose claim record shows no decision, the amount claimed for an item not as described is fixed only after that claim, if its seller response period has run out, the seller has not refunded every one of its claimed units and its claimed line carries no return request, carries a decision on its claim record; where that claim is referred to a human representative under its own policy, the filing is referred too and nothing is filed.
